name: Flowvia Stock Alerts for WooCommerce
author: flowvia

sections.description:
Stock Alerts gives shop administrators and authorised shop managers a simple stock exception report inside WooCommerce.

  • Run a report when you choose. No automatic scans.
  • Review published simple products only.
  • Find low-stock, out-of-stock and backordered products, and missing managed stock quantities.
  • Use each product’s low-stock amount, falling back to WooCommerce’s global low-stock amount (or 2 if invalid).
  • See product ID, SKU, name, quantity, threshold and status.
  • Review all eligible product candidates, 500 per report page, ordered by product ID. Previous/Next controls continue through larger catalogues.
  • English interface with a bundled Danish translation.

Products and stock are never changed. Only products the current user can edit are included. The report can therefore cover fewer products than the shop’s entire catalogue.

This free edition has no email, scheduling, variation reports, custom plugin thresholds, exports or account requirements. It is functional without a paid plan. Flowvia’s separate Pro edition adds variation reporting, a custom fallback threshold, optional daily email and variation reports and optional automation. Nothing is automatically installed or connected to a paid service.

Privacy

No customer or order data is read. The plugin reads product information to display an admin-only report. It does not retain reports, create settings, send email, call an external service, include analytics or transmit data to Flowvia. WordPress and WooCommerce retain their own normal data independently.

Release status

Version 1.0.2 is prepared for the first WordPress.org submission. It has not yet been submitted to or approved by WordPress.org.

Free vs Pro

Free: Manual stock checks for published simple products, with pagination through the full eligible catalogue. No email or scheduling.

Pro: Includes variations and shared stock pools, up to 5,000 scan candidates, a configurable fallback threshold and an optional daily email summary.

Pro is a separate paid package; purchase availability is shown on the product page. Compare Stock Alerts Pro. Free requires no Flowvia account, subscription or licence key.

Support and testing

For setup questions and reproducible bug reports, contact hello@flowvia.dk. Include plugin, WordPress, WooCommerce and PHP versions and steps using synthetic data. Do not send credentials or customer records. WordPress.org support will use the plugin support forum after the directory listing exists.
sections.installation:
1. Use a staging site with WordPress 6.5+, PHP 8.1+ and active WooCommerce.
  2. Open Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin and upload the plugin ZIP.
  3. Activate Flowvia Stock Alerts for WooCommerce.
  4. Open WooCommerce > Stock Alerts Free as an administrator or authorised shop manager.
  5. Click Run stock check.
sections.faq:
Is a Pro subscription required to use this plugin?

No. The free functionality has no trial expiry and requires no paid account. Pro is a separate package, not a feature unlock in this ZIP.

Does this send stock emails?

No. It does not send emails or alter WooCommerce’s existing email settings. WooCommerce itself may still send its usual notifications.

Does this support variable products?

No. The free edition reports published simple products only. Variations and their parent stock pools are outside its scope.

Can I review a large shop?

Yes. Each report page checks up to 500 candidates to bound request time and memory. Use Next and Previous to review all eligible products; there is no total catalogue cutoff or paid upgrade needed to continue. Page counts describe that page only. Catalogue changes between requests may shift products between pages; rerun the report after updates.

Why do Quantity and Threshold show a dash?

When WooCommerce does not track stock quantities for a product, numeric quantities and low-stock thresholds do not apply. Both cells show a dash. The product can still be reported from its explicit Out of stock or On backorder status. No stock setting is changed.

Does zero quantity always mean out of stock?

WooCommerce’s explicit out-of-stock or backorder status is respected. For managed quantities, a quantity at or below the threshold is flagged as low stock, or backorder when backorders are allowed and quantity is zero or negative. This tool does not change WooCommerce’s stock status.

Do I need a Flowvia account?

No. No registration, subscription, licence key or third-party service is needed.

Can I uninstall it?

Yes. Deactivate and delete it using WordPress Plugins. This edition creates no settings, report records or scheduled jobs to remove. It does not modify WooCommerce data.
